name: US straight-wall tote 23.75 x 15.75 x 8.25 in
description:
A US straight-wall stacking container, 23.75 x 15.75 x 8.25 in (603 x 400 x 210 mm), modelled on the Akro-Mils 37688 solid-wall tote from the Akro-Mils straight- wall catalogue. Nominal 24 x 16 in, which in practice is the 600 x 400 mm euro module, so it sits on the same pallet pattern as a euro crate.

External dimensions: length 603 mm, width 400 mm, height 210 mm.

US catalogue equivalent of the 600 x 400 euro module: nominal 24 x 16 in (and its 16 x 12 half), which is 600 x 400 mm in practice.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 4,724 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: US straight-wall tote, 23.75 x 15.75 x 8.25 in (603 x 400 x 210 mm) - true-scale GLB of the Akro-Mils 37688 solid-wall stacking container.
